title: End a run whose route did not come up input
description: A run waited for its route up to the least `start_wait_seconds` of the routes that cannot answer and a route of it still could not answer, or the gateway answered the wake of a route the run sent or joined `spend-ceiling` (a pod start would pass a cap of the gateway; WaitForRoute): the run is Ended with the outcome `stopped: route`, and `route_phase` holds the last phase the gateway gave. No call was sent to the route. The daemon also writes the run event `runbook.route-wait-ended` (record: route, phase, and ceiling `spend-ceiling` when that answer ended the wait) just before the run is Ended; see CancelRun for why it is stated here. Issued by the daemon itself (actor DaemonProcess): it has no route in the HTTP contract.

phase.description: The last phase the gateway gave of the route's model.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
